decision_contract.fallback: retain the wall spectrum as a mechanism-aligned diagnostic and ranker
decision_contract.promotion: every primary case must pass quantitative metrics, threshold sides, and within-packet family ordering

derivation.distortion: quadrature sum of modal phase-spread and encounter-scaled orthogonal contamination
derivation.finite_time_bound: distortion is bounded at leading order by phase-spread plus encounter-scaled contamination; the quadrature form is the calibrated nonnegative approximation
derivation.leakage: exact packet leakage plus a calibrated square of encounter-scaled contamination
derivation.phase: mean modal response bias accumulated over full cycles and converted to spatial shift

noise_selftest.kind: deterministic exact-image and repeated metric evaluation

objective: quantitative transfer of the marched wall spectrum to held-out packets

primary_matrix.justification: low, intermediate, and near-Nyquist carriers cross declared response and contamination sides; two widths separate narrow and broad modal support; four and eight encounters test finite-time accumulation beyond calibration horizons
